traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Mind meets imagination. Strong imagination and intuitive, associative thinking. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Slippery memory and blurred facts; what's real and what's imagined get confused. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for thinking against imagination, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the thinking/imagination form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Creative ideation; verify the details before acting on them.
shadow: Scattered overthinking collides with illusion and escapism; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.summary: A rumor travels faster than anyone can check the facts.
readerCopy.body: A rumor travels faster than anyone can check the facts. The screenshot looks convincing, but the source may be a repost, the time may be wrong, or one missing detail may change the outcome. Mercury keeps the chatter moving, while Neptune blurs where truth ended and embellishment began. The square makes each attempt to verify the story feel slower and less satisfying than repeating it. An official correction may arrive later, but the wrong version could already be the one everyone remembers.
